trace.content: What brings you in today? Please describe your main symptoms and complaints.

7. He reports an intense fear of loud noises reminiscent of his experiences in Iraq

[RESPONSE] I’ve been having upsetting dreams, flashbacks, and intense anxiety—especially around loud noises—since returning from Iraq three months ago; these symptoms started about seven weeks ago. I’m constantly on edge, have trouble sleeping, feel guilty about things that happened during deployment, and I’ve been avoiding places like shooting ranges that remind me of combat. Lately, I’ve even been refusing to leave the house unless my wife persuades me.
